transcript: If you ask me to name a restaurant in Roella that understands branding, White House is obviously in the conversation.This isn't a restaurant that opened on a Tuesday. White House started in 1993 and has grown into a multi-location restaurant brand with establishments in aqua, bonamos adi, bon apprizo and yao ande. And that is an interesting part. They are not just selling pizza or food, they are selling a brand, restaurants, catering events, reservations and experience. But yes, where things get interesting, imagine building a restaurant this successful and building your digital presence on somebody else's land. TikTok is rented land. Instagram, Facebook or rented land. You can build your audience there, but you don't own the platform, you don't own who sees you tomorrow. They can take it away from you on a Tuesday. A website is different, that's your digital property and White House actually owns the land. In 2026, that matters even more. People aren't only asking Instagram. They are not asking TrigyPity, perplexity, clothes, what to eat, where to stay, who to trust. The real question is, when someone asks AI to recommend a business or a restaurant like yours, does your digital property allows for that? Because having a website in 2026 isn't a flex, being found, understood, recommended is, is your business AI visible? Comment AI and I will show you how to check. [BLANK_AUDIO]
